_comment: Pinned spec for the vetted Nscale NeMo validation container baked by build_vetted_nemo_image.sh. The ~34GB .sqsh artifact itself lives on NFS (and optionally a dist/air-gapped bundle), not in git.

swaps.reason: container NCCL 2.28.3 segfaults at MNNVL init on GB200 NVL72 (single- and multi-node); PyTorch loads this same system libnccl, so one swap fixes NCCL pre-checks AND training

not_touched.note: UCX/HPC-X are the crash REPORTER (signal handler), not the cause — left as-is

validated.evidence: LD_PRELOAD of 2.28.9 into the stock container -> all_reduce_perf_mpi clean, 0 wrong, no segfault; host portable NCCL 2.28.9 = ~914 GB/s over MNNVL; nvlink_preflight PASS
